name: Unfumble
soft_passes: #2 glyph optically low-left as sparkle counterweight — intentional but a nudge
#3 silhouette carried by interior line-art strokes, not a filled outline
#10 white glyph is background-independent so it survives, but no authored dark/tinted/glass variant ships
#11 a device exists (sparkle badge) but it is the template-default stock-symbol pairing on a blue gradient
failures: #4 16px squint: wireframe grille collapses to a light blob, globe-ness lost — acute for a menu-bar app that lives at ~16px

palette.background: ramp #0C76FE->#4F5CF6 (diagonal azure top-left -> indigo bottom-right, hue cools ~213->230)

light_model: Flat/non-dimensional. Gradient field implies soft top-left sky light; glyph is flat white line-art with no cast shadow, specular, bevel, or refraction. Baked system drop shadow behind the mask is a render artifact, not authored depth.
layer_stack: white four-point sparkle badge (knocks out globe strokes beneath)
devices: sparkle-on-globe (globe=language/international, sparkle=automatic/magic) — the one identity move, but stock-symbol pairing
hue-drifting diagonal ramp (cools azure->indigo, not just value-darkens)
brand-colour coherence: icon azure is the brand accent echoed in the cover tagline
rhymes_hint: the 'SF-Symbol glyph on a blue->indigo gradient squircle' utility family (translation/VPN/network/menu-bar tools reaching for the globe); style family = blue-gradient-squircle utility template; nearest reflex Apple Translate/Safari globe motifs
notes: Delivered 512x512 not 1024 master; corners transparent with baked system drop shadow -> web render (masked+shadowed), not a raw full-bleed layer. No glass/specular/translucency present -> Big Sur flat-gradient-squircle, NOT Liquid Glass, and no Icon Composer dark/tinted variant authored. Glyph is literally the stock SF Symbols globe + sparkle composited (assembled-from-system-parts tell). Subject (keyboard language switching) is absent from the mark — defaults to generic 'internationalisation=globe' reflex; no key/cursor/glyph-pair. #4 16px fail is borderline (round silhouette persists, grille does not) but consequential for a menu-bar utility. First icon of this template family in the corpus; anchor for a future stock-symbol-utility icon cluster once >=2 more land.
